first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single human-shaped subject wearing a dark red-and-blue bodysuit and a full-coverage hood, flipping while descending above the city.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of gray clouds above the city, with alternating light and dark areas and soft edges.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: Densely distributed reddish-brown, gray, and dark-colored buildings, including window-grid facades and flat roofs.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: Gray roads between the buildings and intersections with white zebra crossings.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of trees with green and yellow-green crowns along both sides of the roads and in open spaces between buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A collection of multiple background vehicles with light- and dark-colored bodies on the city roads.

entities.name: Distant water surface
entities.identification: A broad gray-blue body of water extending into the distance behind the nearby cluster of city buildings.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: The large orange-brown rectangular patterned area on the exterior wall of the building on the right indicated by the source ID.

entities.name: Orange-yellow vertical frame
entities.identification: The slender orange-yellow frame along the side of the building slightly left of the center of the image, with parallel sides and connecting crossbars visible.
